The FloPlast strap boss 110mm provides a reliable connection solution for drainage systems, allowing the attachment of waste pipes to soil pipes. This robust grey uPVC boss is an essential component for plumbing installations, particularly when adding new waste outlets in a variety of properties. It features an easy clip connection for efficient fitting to soil pipes. The product is supplied with 32 and 40mm push-fit boss adaptors, and can accommodate 32, 40, and 50mm waste pipes, making it versatile for various plumbing requirements.
